# DEEPDELL — Full Machine-Readable Context

> Deep technology. Clear impact.

DEEPDELL is a digital engineering company focused on digital commerce, Shopify Plus engineering, AI agents, agentic automation, business automation, systems integration, data and business intelligence, custom software and technical SEO/CRO.

## Capabilities

### Shopify Plus Engineering
Enterprise storefronts, Shopify Markets, B2B commerce, multi-store architecture, custom themes, Liquid, headless commerce, checkout extensions, Shopify APIs and GraphQL integrations.

### AI & Agentic Automation
Production AI agents, tool-using workflows, copilots, knowledge systems, AI commerce, natural-language analytics and agentic workflows with business guardrails.

### Business Automation
Event-driven workflows, scheduled pipelines, bots, operational automations and connected business systems.

### Systems Integration
ERP, CRM, POS, PIM, WMS, logistics, payments, marketplaces and custom API integrations.

### Data & Business Intelligence
Dashboards, reporting automation, data pipelines, KPI systems, analytics and data warehouses.

### Custom Software & SaaS
Web platforms, portals, APIs, SaaS products and scalable digital products.

### Technical SEO & CRO
Technical SEO, performance optimization, analytics, experimentation and conversion engineering.

## Technology ecosystem
Shopify, Shopify Plus, React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, Magento, GraphQL, Python, OpenAI, Supabase, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Cloudflare, Vercel, Docker, GitHub, AWS, Stripe, Google Analytics, Klaviyo and Odoo.
